Class ThreadPoolTaskExecutor

java.lang.Object
org.springframework.util.CustomizableThreadCreator
org.springframework.scheduling.concurrent.CustomizableThreadFactory
org.springframework.scheduling.concurrent.ExecutorConfigurationSupport
org.springframework.scheduling.concurrent.ThreadPoolTaskExecutor
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable, Executor, ThreadFactory, EventListener, Aware, BeanNameAware, DisposableBean, InitializingBean, ApplicationContextAware, ApplicationListener<ContextClosedEvent>, Lifecycle, Phased, SmartLifecycle, AsyncTaskExecutor, TaskExecutor, SchedulingTaskExecutor
public class ThreadPoolTaskExecutor extends ExecutorConfigurationSupport implements AsyncTaskExecutor, SchedulingTaskExecutor
JavaBean that allows for configuring a ThreadPoolExecutor in bean style (through its "corePoolSize", "maxPoolSize", "keepAliveSeconds", "queueCapacity" properties) and exposing it as a Spring TaskExecutor. This class is also well suited for management and monitoring (for example, through JMX), providing several useful attributes: "corePoolSize", "maxPoolSize", "keepAliveSeconds" (all supporting updates at runtime); "poolSize", "activeCount" (for introspection only).

默认配置的核心线程池大小为 1，最大线程池大小和队列容量均为无限。这大致相当于 Executors.newSingleThreadExecutor()，即所有任务共享单个线程。将 "queueCapacity" 设置为 0 可模拟 Executors.newCachedThreadPool()，线程池中的线程会立即扩展至可能非常高的数量。在此情况下，还应考虑设置 "maxPoolSize"，以及可能需要更高的 "corePoolSize"（另请参阅 "allowCoreThreadTimeOut" 扩展模式）。

注意：该类实现了 Spring 的TaskExecutor接口以及Executor接口，其中前者为主要接口，后者仅作为辅助便利。因此，异常处理遵循 TaskExecutor 契约而非 Executor 契约，特别是关于TaskRejectedException的部分。

作为替代方案，您可以使用构造函数注入直接设置 `ThreadPoolExecutor` 实例，或者使用指向 Executors 类的工厂方法定义。要将此类原始 `Executor` 暴露为 Spring TaskExecutor，只需将其包装在 ConcurrentTaskExecutor 适配器中。

2.0

      public void setQueueCapacity(int queueCapacity)

      默认值为Integer.MAX_VALUE。

      任何正值将导致创建一个 LinkedBlockingQueue 实例；任何其他值将导致创建一个 SynchronousQueue 实例。

    • setAllowCoreThreadTimeOut

      public void setAllowCoreThreadTimeOut(boolean allowCoreThreadTimeOut)
      Specify whether to allow core threads to time out. This enables dynamic growing and shrinking even in combination with a non-zero queue (since the max pool size will only grow once the queue is full).

      默认值为"false"。

      See Also:

      public void setPrestartAllCoreThreads(boolean prestartAllCoreThreads)

    • setStrictEarlyShutdown

      public void setStrictEarlyShutdown(boolean defaultEarlyShutdown)
      Specify whether to initiate an early shutdown signal on context close, disposing all idle threads and rejecting further task submissions.

      默认情况下，现有任务将在协调的生命周期停止阶段内被允许完成。此设置仅控制是否在上下文关闭时触发显式的 ThreadPoolExecutor.shutdown() 调用，从而在该点之后拒绝任务提交。

      自 6.1.4 版本起，默认值为 "false"，宽容地允许任务在上下文关闭后到达，但仍参与生命周期停止阶段。请注意，这与 ExecutorConfigurationSupport.setAcceptTasksAfterContextClose(boolean) 不同，后者完全绕过协调的生命周期停止阶段，根本不对现有任务的完成进行显式等待。

      将此项切换为 "true"，以发出严格的早期关闭信号，类似于 ThreadPoolTaskScheduler 在 6.1 版本中建立的默认行为。请注意，相关的标志 ExecutorConfigurationSupport.setAcceptTasksAfterContextClose(boolean) 和 ExecutorConfigurationSupport.setWaitForTasksToCompleteOnShutdown(boolean) 将覆盖此设置，导致在没有协调的生命周期停止阶段的情况下进行延迟关闭。

      Since:
      6.1.4
      See Also:
      • ExecutorConfigurationSupport.initiateShutdown()

    • setTaskDecorator

      public void setTaskDecorator(TaskDecorator taskDecorator)
      Specify a custom TaskDecorator to be applied to any Runnable about to be executed.

      注意，此类装饰器并非必然应用于用户提供的 `Runnable`/`Callable`，而是应用于实际的执行回调（该回调可能是对用户所提供任务的包装）。

      主要用例是在任务调用周围设置一些执行上下文，或为任务执行提供一些监控/统计信息。

      注意：TaskDecorator 实现中的异常处理仅限于通过 execute 调用执行的普通 Runnable。对于 #submit 调用，暴露的 Runnable 将是一个 FutureTask，它不会传播任何异常；您可能需要将其转换为 Future 并调用 Future#get 来评估异常。有关如何在此类 Future 情况下访问异常的示例，请参阅 ThreadPoolExecutor#afterExecute 的 Javadoc。

      Since:
      4.3

      public Future<?> submit(Runnable task)
      描述从接口复制：AsyncTaskExecutor

    • initiateEarlyShutdown

      protected void initiateEarlyShutdown()
      描述从类复制：ExecutorConfigurationSupport
      Early shutdown signal: do not trigger further tasks, let existing tasks complete before hitting the actual destruction step in the ExecutorConfigurationSupport.shutdown() method. This goes along with a coordinated lifecycle stop phase.

      由 ExecutorConfigurationSupport.onApplicationEvent(ContextClosedEvent) 调用，前提是未检测到延迟关闭的迹象，即如果尚未设置 "acceptTasksAfterContextClose" 和 "waitForTasksToCompleteOnShutdown" 标志。

      默认实现调用ExecutorConfigurationSupport.initiateShutdown()。

      Overrides:
      `ExecutorConfigurationSupport` 类中的 `initiateEarlyShutdown`
      See Also:
      • ExecutorConfigurationSupport.initiateShutdown()
